Mutant Feature - Fish Head.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Fish Head
A smooth fish head with side-set eyes, gill covers and a fin crest on a human body.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Fish Head.traitNarrativeEffects:
Visual selection only: a permanent Mutant feature of the body; keep it in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; Quirk traits decide what it can do. Features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. Quirkless or No Quirk means no heteromorph body: do not draw this feature.
Portrait: a fish's head on a human neck and body: streamlined, rounded snout, wide down-turned mouth, large round lidless side-set eyes visible from the front, a gill cover at each jaw hinge, a low fin crest over the top of the head. Wet-sheened skin in the selected skin color, paler under jaw and throat. No hair: the selected hair color tints the fin crest; Hair Style and facial hair traits are skipped. If another Mutant Feature adds ears, a beak or tusks, this head's own anatomy takes precedence.
